4 September 2026

Stelrad Group PLC

Notification and public disclosure of transactions by persons discharging managerial responsibilities and persons closely associated with them

Stelrad Group plc ("Stelrad" or "the Group" or "the Company", LSE: SRAD) announces that on 3 September 2026, Robert Ellis, Non-Executive Director, sold 166,734 ordinary shares in the Company ("shares") at a price of £1.457 per share.

The sale was conducted pursuant to a personal financial planning exercise. Following this transaction, Robert Ellis has an interest in 2,447,048 shares, representing 1.92% of the Company's share capital.

The Notification of Dealing Form can be found below.

This notiﬁcation is made in accordance with the UK version of the EU Market Abuse Regulation 596/2014.
